# OpenSpec: Sprint F — Wissensnetz SSR & SEO

**Status**: Draft
**Version**: 1.0
**Owner**: Sisyphus
**Created**: 2026-06-26

---

## 1. Purpose & Goal

Entity detail pages (`/entity/{slug}/`) are currently entirely client-side rendered: the Hugo template outputs a skeleton loader, then JavaScript fetches `/api/kg-data`, finds the matching entity, and builds the HTML via DOM manipulation. This means:

- **Google indexes zero entity content** — no title, no description, no structured data
- **Social media previews (OG/Twitter) show generic fallback** — no entity-specific description
- **Users see a loading skeleton before content** — higher perceived latency
- **No JSON-LD structured data** — no rich search results (Knowledge Panel, Rich Snippets)

**Goal**: Server-render all entity detail page content from Hugo data files at build time. Client-side JS only handles the interactive ego-graph and dynamic enrichment. This unlocks SEO indexing, social previews, and faster perceived load time.

---

## 2. Scope

### Must Have (Sprint F)

| #   | Deliverable                                                                                                                                | Files                                  | Effort |
| --- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------- | ------ |
| F1  | **SSR entity detail** — render name, category badge, description, article count, relation count from `.Site.Data.kg_data` in Hugo template | `myhugoapp/layouts/entity/single.html` | 3d     |
| F2  | **JSON-LD structured data** — Schema.org `DefinedTerm` for each entity page                                                                | `myhugoapp/layouts/entity/single.html` | 1d     |
| F3  | **SEO meta tags** — proper `<title>`, `<meta name="description">`, `<link rel="canonical">`, OG tags, Twitter Card on entity pages         | `myhugoapp/layouts/entity/single.html` | 1d     |
| F4  | **Entity sitemap** — ensure `/entity/` pages appear in Hugo sitemap                                                                        | `myhugoapp/config.toml`                | 0.5d   |
| F5  | **Enhanced entity frontmatter** — `generate-entity-pages.mjs` embeds category, articleCount, description from `kg_data.json`               | `scripts/generate-entity-pages.mjs`    | 1d     |
| F6  | **Build pipeline** — wire `kg_data.json` export into Hugo build                                                                            | `myhugoapp/package.json` or CI config  | 0.5d   |
| F7  | **Tests** — SSR content, JSON-LD validity, SEO tags, sitemap                                                                               | `tests/`                               | 2d     |

### Must NOT Have

- No changes to `/api/kg-data` endpoint or Neo4j queries
- No changes to client-side rendering fallback (must still work when kg_data.json is missing)
- No changes to entity-index.html or entity-index.js (Sprint G handles those)
- No CSS redesign or dark mode changes
- No changes to curricula, KI-Assistent, or calculator pages
- No new npm packages
- No ESM migration

## 3. Data Contracts

### 3.1 Source: `myhugoapp/data/kg_data.json`

Generated by `scripts/export-kg-data.mjs` (already exists). Shape:

```json
{
  "source": "neo4j",
  "entities": [
    {
      "name": "Wasser",
      "category": "stoff",
      "description": "...",
      "articleCount": 5,
      "articles": [{ "id": "...", "title": "...", "url": "...", "date": "..." }],
      "relatedEntities": ["Sauerstoff", "Wasserstoff", ...],
      "components": ["H2O-Molekül", ...],
      "curriculumMeta": { ... }
    }
  ],
  "articles": [...],
  "updatedAt": "2026-06-26T..."
}
```

### 3.2 Hugo Data Access

In `entity/single.html`, Hugo accesses the data via:

```
{{ $entities := .Site.Data.kg_data.entities }}
{{ $currentSlug := .Params.slug }}
```

Then in Go template, find the entity matching `$currentSlug` and render its fields.

### 3.3 Entity Page Frontmatter (Generated)

Each `content/entity/{slug}/index.md` has:

```yaml
---
title: 'Wasser'
description: 'Fachbegriff: Wasser — 5 Artikel auf chemie-lernen.org'
date: 2026-06-03
slug: 'wasser'
category: 'stoff'
articleCount: 5
---
```

### 3.4 JSON-LD Output

```json
<script type="application/ld+json">
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "DefinedTerm",
  "name": "Wasser",
  "description": "Fachbegriff: Wasser — 5 Artikel auf chemie-lernen.org",
  "inLanguage": "de-DE",
  "url": "https://chemie-lernen.org/entity/wasser/",
  "termCode": "wasser",
  "category": "stoff",
  "mainEntityOfPage": {
    "@type": "WebPage",
    "@id": "https://chemie-lernen.org/entity/wasser/"
  },
  "mentions": [
    { "@type": "CreativeWork", "name": "...", "url": "..." }
  ]
}
</script>
```

## 4. Interface Specifications

### 4.1 `entity/single.html` — Template Structure Change

**Current flow**:

```
{{ define "main" }}
  [breadcrumb]
  [skeleton div]        ← visible by default
  [content div]         ← hidden by default
  <script>
    fetch(/api/kg-data) → render() → populate content div → hide skeleton
  </script>
{{ end }}
```

**Target flow**:

```
{{ define "main" }}
  [breadcrumb]
  [SSR entity content]  ← rendered from .Site.Data.kg_data
  [skeleton div]        ← hidden by default (only shows if SSR data missing)
  [ego-graph container] ← empty div, populated by client JS
  <script>
    // Check if SSR data exists
    // If yes: only initialize ego-graph (skip fetch, skip full render)
    // If no:  fall back to full client-side render (current behavior)
  </script>
{{ end }}
```

### 4.2 Client JS Behavior Change

The inline `<script>` in `entity/single.html` must be modified:

**New logic**:

```
1. Check: does SSR content div exist AND has content?
   - YES: skip fetch. Only start initEgoGraph() using data from SSR.
   - NO:  fall back to current behavior (fetch /api/kg-data → full render).
2. Fuzzy slug matching (the "Meinten Sie" feature) still works in both paths.
```

### 4.3 `generate-entity-pages.mjs` — Enhanced Frontmatter

Add these fields to entity page frontmatter:

```yaml
category: 'stoff'
articleCount: 5
relatedCount: 12
```

These are read from `kg_data.json` during generation.

### 4.4 SEO Meta Tags Block

Add to `entity/single.html` (in the `{{ define "css" }}` or a new `{{ define "seo" }}` block):

- `<title>{{ .Title }} – chemie-lernen.org</title>` (override default if needed)
- `<meta name="description" content="...">` (read from frontmatter)
- `<link rel="canonical" href="{{ .Permalink }}">`
- `<meta property="og:title" content="...">`
- `<meta property="og:description" content="...">`
- `<meta property="og:type" content="article">`
- `<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary">`
- `<meta name="twitter:title" content="...">`
- `<meta name="twitter:description" content="...">`

**Notes**: the global `head.html` partial already sets canonical + OG for all pages, but for entity pages we want entity-specific content rather than the generic site-level description.

## 5. Behavior Specifications

### 5.1 SSR Content Rendering

**Given**: Entity page `/entity/wasser/` is requested
**When**: Hugo builds the page
**Then**:

- The page HTML source contains the entity name ("Wasser") in an `<h1>` tag
- The page HTML source contains the category badge ("Stoff") with correct category color
- The page HTML source contains the article count ("5 Artikel")
- The page HTML source contains the relation count ("12 Verknüpfungen")
- The page HTML source contains the list of related entity tags (KMK, Quelle, etc.)
- The page HTML source contains the list of linked articles (if any)
- The page HTML source contains JSON-LD structured data
- The skeleton loader is NOT visible in the initial HTML (display:none)
- No client-side JS is required to see this content

**Fallback**: If `kg_data.json` is missing or the slug isn't found, the SSR section remains empty/fallback, and client JS takes over as before.

### 5.2 Client-Side Enhancement

**Given**: SSR content is present
**When**: The page's inline JS executes
**Then**:

- The JS detects that SSR content already exists (via a data attribute or DOM check)
- The JS does NOT re-fetch `/api/kg-data`
- The JS does NOT re-render the header card
- The JS initializes only:
  1. The ego-graph (lazy-load D3, render force layout)
  2. Any interactive tooltips/hover on relation tags

### 5.3 Client-Side Fallback

**Given**: SSR content is NOT present (kg_data.json missing or slug not found)
**When**: The page's inline JS executes
**Then**:

- The JS fetches `/api/kg-data` as before
- The JS renders the full entity detail (current behavior)
- The skeleton loader shows until data arrives
- Fuzzy slug matching ("Meinten Sie") works as before

### 5.4 Fuzzy Slug Matching Enhancement

**Given**: URL `/entity/wasserstoff/` but exact slug is `wasserstoff-1`
**When**: SSR cannot find the entity by exact slug match
**Then**:

- SSR renders a fallback section with "Meinten Sie: Wasserstoff?" and links to `/entity/wasserstoff-1/`
- If SSR data is missing entirely, client JS fallback handles it as before

### 5.5 JSON-LD Validity

**Given**: Any entity page
**Then**:

- The page contains exactly one `<script type="application/ld+json">` block for the entity's structured data
- The JSON-LD validates against Schema.org `DefinedTerm` schema
- The `name` property matches the entity name
- The `description` property uses the entity's description
- The `url` property is the full canonical URL
- The `mentions` array includes linked articles (up to 10)

### 5.6 SEO Meta Tags

**Given**: Any entity page
**Then**:

- `<title>` = "Wasser – chemie-lernen.org" (entity name + site title)
- `<meta name="description">` contains entity description
- `<link rel="canonical">` points to `/entity/{slug}/`
- `<meta property="og:title">` = entity name
- `<meta property="og:description">` = entity description
- `<meta property="og:url">` = full canonical URL
- `<meta name="twitter:card">` = "summary"

### 5.7 Entity Sitemap

**Given**: Hugo build completes
**Then**:

- `public/sitemap.xml` contains entries for all `/entity/{slug}/` pages
- Each entity sitemap entry has the correct `lastmod` date
- Entity sitemap entries use standard priority (0.5) or higher (0.7+ for entities with many articles)

### 5.8 Build Pipeline

**Given**: Hugo build is triggered (via `npm run build` or CI)
**Then**:

- Before Hugo runs, `scripts/export-kg-data.mjs` executes (if Neo4j available)
- If Neo4j is unavailable, the script logs a warning and exits 0 (non-fatal)
- `scripts/generate-entity-pages.mjs` runs after export (or uses existing kg_data.json if export skipped)
- Hugo build uses the generated entity pages and kg_data.json

## 7. Implementation Strategy

### 7.1 Dependency Order

```
F5: generate-entity-pages.mjs enhancement (frontmatter enrichment)
    ↓
F1: entity/single.html SSR template (uses enhanced frontmatter + kg_data.json)
    ↓
F2: JSON-LD structured data (depends on F1's data flow)
F3: SEO meta tags (depends on F1's template structure)
F4: Sitemap config (independent, can parallelize with F2/F3)
F6: Build pipeline (depends on F5)
F7: Tests (depends on all above)
```

### 7.2 Technical Approach

**SSR Detection Pattern**: Use a `data-ssr` attribute:

```html
<div id="entity-ssr-content" data-ssr="true">...server-rendered content...</div>
```

Client JS checks `document.getElementById('entity-ssr-content')?.dataset.ssr === 'true'` to decide SSR vs fetch path.

**Template Logic** (Go template pseudocode):

```go
{{ $entities := .Site.Data.kg_data.entities }}
{{ $slug := .Params.slug }}
{{ $entity := index (where $entities "name" "|" ... ) 0 }} // need slug-based lookup
{{ if $entity }}
  <div id="entity-ssr-content" data-ssr="true">
    {{/* render name, badge, stats, articles, relations */}}
  </div>
  <script>window.__SSR_ENTITY = {{ $entity | jsonify }};</script>
{{ else }}
  <div id="entity-ssr-content" data-ssr="false">
    <!-- skeleton will show, JS will hydrate -->
  </div>
{{ end }}
```

Actually simpler: `generate-entity-pages.mjs` already embeds per-entity data in frontmatter (title, description, slug). We can use `.Title`, `.Description`, `.Params.category`, `.Params.articleCount` directly in the template for the basics, and use `.Site.Data.kg_data` only for richer data (related entities, articles list). This approach means even without kg_data.json, the entity name and description still render server-side from frontmatter.

**Two-layer SSR approach**:

1. **Layer 1 (always available)**: Frontmatter fields — `{{ .Title }}`, `{{ .Description }}`, `{{ .Params.category }}`, `{{ .Params.articleCount }}` — rendered directly in template.
2. **Layer 2 (kg_data.json dependent)**: Related entities, articles list, component list — rendered from `.Site.Data.kg_data` when available.

- Use existing `partials/structured-data.html` as pattern for JSON-LD (but inline it in entity/single.html for entity-specific data)
- Use existing `.Site.Data.kg_data` access pattern from `ki-assistent.html` as reference
- Use existing Playwright test patterns from `test-entity-knowledge-graph.spec.js` for SSR tests

## 8. Verification Strategy

### 8.1 Automated Verification

All acceptance criteria in Section 6 must be verified via:

1. **`node --check`** — syntax check on all JS files
2. **`npm run lint`** — ESLint 0 errors
3. **`npm run test:coverage`** — ≥70% threshold
4. **Playwright E2E tests** — 10+ new test cases:
   - SSR content visible in HTML source (JS disabled)
   - JSON-LD block present and parseable
   - Meta tags (title, description, OG, canonical)
   - Sitemap includes entity URLs
   - Ego graph renders (JS enabled)
   - Fallback when kg_data.json is missing
   - Fuzzy slug matching
   - No `/api/kg-data` fetch when SSR data exists
5. **`hugo build`** — exit 0 with entity pages

### 8.2 Manual QA

- [ ] Visit `/entity/wasser/` with JS disabled → SSR content visible
- [ ] Visit `/entity/wasser/` with JS enabled → ego-graph renders
- [ ] Visit `/entity/wasserstoff/` (fuzzy slug) → "Meinten Sie" banner
- [ ] Run Google Rich Results Test on `/entity/wasser/`
- [ ] Share `/entity/wasser/` on social media → correct OG preview

## 10. Risk Register

| Risk                                                                   | L      | I      | Mitigation                                                             |
| ---------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ | ------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Hugo `.Data` from `kg_data.json` not available at template render time | Low    | High   | Use frontmatter fields as Layer 1 fallback; kg_data as enrichment only |
| Entity slug in URL doesn't match frontmatter slug                      | Low    | Medium | Add `{{ .Params.slug }}` check; fuzzy fallback in template             |
| Large entity count increases build time                                | Medium | Low    | Profile; parallel entity generation if needed                          |
| JSON-LD `DefinedTerm` not recognized by Google                         | Low    | Medium | Test with Rich Results Test Tool; fallback to `Thing` if needed        |
| Client-side JS still fetches API even with SSR data                    | Medium | Medium | Add strict SSR detection + Playwright test verifying no fetch          |
| Existing tests break due to entity/single.html changes                 | Medium | Medium | Run full test suite before commit; test-first approach                 |
